question:
Fill in the blanks:

During a Financial Emergency, the salaries of judges can be reduced by the ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**President**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 
• **Financial Emergency**: The term "Financial Emergency" is defined under **Article 360** of the **Indian Constitution**. It allows the **President** of India to take specific measures to safeguard the financial stability of the country. 
• During a Financial Emergency, the **President** has the power to reduce the salaries and allowances of all government employees, including **judges of the Supreme Court and High Courts**. 
• Such measures are implemented to ensure the proper allocation and management of financial resources during the crisis. ***Hence, the correct answer is "President."*** 
• The proclamation of a Financial Emergency requires the approval of both Houses of Parliament within two months of its issuance.
